class.name: SteamPublisherLeaderboards
class.brief_description: Submits authoritative leaderboard scores from a trusted backend.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamPublisher.leaderboards] after the game has authorized the run and verified the player. The configured publisher must have write access to the board.

method.name: submit_score
method.description: Submits a signed 32-bit [param score] using KeepBest for a verified player and a positive Valve board ID. Accepts up to 256 raw details bytes. Use [code]await[/code] to receive [SteamLeaderboardSubmissionResult]. Success acknowledges the HTTP submission. The publisher endpoint does not document rank or change fields, so the result carries the submitted score and no [member SteamLeaderboardSubmission.upload] receipt.
